limits: Labels use source and final contexts in fixed historical runs; they do not establish causal graph benefit.
The 12-case fixed random sample is small and drawn from a score-selected 57-case cohort; counts are descriptive only.
Gold/source ambiguity in conv-26_qa41 and conv-42_qa60 must be kept separate from retrieval effects.
